ambiguities_dose: D1 Runs: S1Z, S1Z1 (the D2 reference) and S1ZD each go through read_s1z.s1z_read in its S1Z slot, as read_rep does for S1Z-recipe runs; E3 scores of changed picks come from table_p6final_c.npz (sha 3bda2080...), never from an arm csv. C0 and C0r are required because s1z_read needs them (P1's zero point and the floor F = |C0r - C0|); the card's CLI lists only the S1Z recipe runs, so --c0 and --c0r are ADDED inputs. They decide nothing in this card.

D2 'Guards' = G1, G2, G3 (Batch 1, vs P6) and G4 (CRUISE slow-pick share) -- all four must pass, exactly as read_rep.py's guards_ok for an S1Z-recipe run. M2 (failure share, S1Z card) is REPORTED next to them (as read_rep reports it) and does not decide. The S1Z/S1Z1 reference runs' guards are printed, not deciding.

D3 Thresholds are computed from the card's printed s_p and t (2.776 * 0.1791 = 0.49718, times sqrt(1.5) = 0.60892) and compared strictly; the card's rounded 0.4972 / 0.6089 are printed next to them (a test pins that they round to the card's values). They differ by < 2e-5.

D4 D2's reference is the mean of the S1Z and S1Z1 per-token E3 PDMS vectors inside each draw (card section 2), on the same draws as D1 and every other statistic. PROVEN iff CI-lo > 0 and d > 0.6089, both strict.

D5 Outcome labels follow section 4 literally: A = D1 and D2 PROVEN and all guards pass; B = D1 PROVEN, D2 not; D = D1 PROVEN and a guard fails; C = D1 NOT PROVEN. Every match is listed; the primary label follows A, B, D, C. B carries no guard clause on the card, so B and D can both match (B first). Unnamed only when D1 or D2 is undefined (non-finite CI).

D6 Regret split = split.py of the P6 navtest read (raw/2026-11-09-p6-navtest-read/selection/split.py) on the card's truth table table_p6final_c.npz, with the arm's pick (navsim_v1 rule on its logits, torch float32, first index on ties) in place of the stored pick; zero-multiplier = pick PDMS 0 while a non-zero proposal existed, TTC-0 = non-zero pick with TTC sub-score 0, rest = every other token; contribution = mean over ALL tokens of (best of 64 - pick) x 100 restricted to the class. Intervals: the shared 10,000 log-cluster draws of this read (split.py used its own multinomial draws, so its printed CIs differ in the later digits; the POINT values are the same).

D7 --sft-log: a JSON-lines file (sft.jsonl or the stdout log); every row with event 'eval' is listed (tag, n, base and B held-out pick x100, B - base with its CI, B zero picks). The card says every 200 updates; the trainer's default --eval-every is 400, so the tags present are printed as found. A monitor only (PREREG_SCORER1P6 section 2): in-sample for P6, decides nothing. Not given: 'not given'.

D8 --p6-pass: the dev-box arm pass's P6_control/e3_logits.npz must reproduce the banked P6 pick on 100 % of tokens and carry bit-identical proposals (gate G0-P6PASS); its logits' bit-equality with the banked P6 logits is reported. A failing gate is READ STOPPED (the pass pipeline would not be the banked P6's).

D9 K ledger: one key per S1ZD E3 read, DOSE:S1ZD:<sha256 of e3_logits.npz>:E3 (family DOSE; style of REP:<run>:<sha>:E3 and S1ZSM:<sha>:E3); S1Z and S1Z1 are re-read as references and NOT keyed (their REP keys exist). D1 and D2 are this card's own pre-registered tests; the Bonferroni interval of d vs P6 at K is for best-of-K statements only.

D10 A real read refuses an S1ZD whose e3_logits.npz is bit-identical to S1Z's, S1Z1's, C0's, C0r's or P6_control's (a 1,600-update arm is never identical to them); --control-standin allows it, stamps CONTROL_NOT_A_RESULT, writes only under F:/tanitad_scratch/dose_read_work and never touches the real ledger.
ambiguities_batch1: A1 plan speed v4: the arms' outputs carry the executed plan as 8 NAVSIM poses at 0.5 s, not the 20-step 0.2 s trajectory the C3 read used. v4 is therefore the chord of the LAST step (|p[7]-p[6]|/0.5) for plans and for the human future alike (same estimator on both sides). Overspeed (v4/v0 > 1.15), slow share (< 0.85) and the Spearman ratio v4/v0 use it. Not tuned: it is the only plan representation in the outputs.

A2 CRUISE: selc6_analyze.cruise_formula applied to the export's own fields on the 0.5 s grid: human future finite, v0 = |ego_velocity| > 5, |ego_acceleration_x| < 0.3, |v4_gt - v0| < 1.0 (v4_gt the human last-step chord). E2/E3 tokens have no 20-step ego-probe record, so tokens_cruise.json cannot be used there.

A3 M1 token set per head: a token enters head h only if its TRUE labels vary AND every arm's predicted head is defined on it (a common set, so every arm difference is paired); n per head is reported. Mean over TTC, NC, DAC of the per-head means.

A4 M1 bar read as written: S1E - C0 >= +0.5 * |dRho_C0| (dRho_C0 = C0's own mean-over-heads gap), CI-lo of S1E - C0 > 0, and |S1E - C0| > 2 * |dRho_C0r - dRho_C0|. The M1 floor is the same C0r-C0 pair as P1's.
A5 F is |C0r - C0| on the point estimates (PDMS x100 on E3 for P1). If C0r is absent F is undefined and no bar that needs F is cleared (conservative).

A6 'clears P1 against P6' for S1E means its own P1 (vs C0 with the 2F rule AND vs P6 CI-lo > 0). For O4 'no arm clears P1 against P6' is read as: neither C0 nor S1E has CI-lo > 0 and |diff| > 2F against P6.

A7 Outcome overlap: O1..O6 are not mutually exclusive as written. Every match is listed (matches); the primary label follows the fixed order O1, O2, O3, O5, O6, O4, Unnamed (most specific first; O5 NOT PROVEN before O4/O6). O3 (S1E harm) is evaluated whether or not C0 is adopted.

A8 Family clause covers LONGITUDINAL (EP, TTC, target-speed accuracy, speed MAE, along-track MAE and final error, accel MAE, overspeed share) and LATERAL (DAC, heading, curvature, yaw-rate, cross-track MAE and final error) components, adverse iff the paired CI of (arm - P6) lies entirely on the worse side. No multiplicity correction is applied (card silent). NC, C, DDC are reported with CIs but sit in G1/PDMS, not in the clause. TACTICAL components are reported with paired CIs and do not enter the clause (the clause text names longitudinal and lateral).

A9 Per-token family components are masked means over the horizon steps (the four_families masks); a token enters a component's bootstrap only where the component is defined for both arm and P6. Distance-keeping is UNAVAILABLE at this tier (card).

A10 E2 and E3 use the arm's logits with the planner's navsim_v1 rule WITHOUT the lane factor (6 outputs): pick = argmax of p_NC*p_DAC*(5 p_EP + 5 p_TTC + 2 p_C)/12 in torch float32, first index on ties. All 64 proposals are treated as valid (E2 table validity is gated).

A11 Unchanged tokens carry P6's banked csv value; a changed token's value is looked up as the score of the SAME proposal index, from P6's csv, the E2 table, or any arm's harness csv (proposals are bit-identical across arms by G0-E3, so a (token, k) score is arm-independent; conflicts stop the read).

A12 Boundary comparisons use a 1e-9 slack in the arm's disfavour only where the card bar is a decimal (G1 -0.5 points, G2/G3 strict '<', goal 94.55): see 'bar' helpers; CI-lo > 0 and |diff| > 2F are strict with no slack.
